root_rulings.subject: Read-only ETag compatibility
root_rulings.decision: Reader retains raw server ETag as optional metadata; missing or weak ETag does not reject a valid seven-field ReviewContext read. Old body validation is retained. Only submit.condition requires a quoted strong tag and forwards its exact bytes.

root_rulings.subject: Current context and frozen request
root_rulings.decision: New mutations use validated current seven-field context (task/run/result/policy/snapshot/object/review), not history rows. ReviewCreate contains exactly eight existing fields, UUIDs are canonicalized, reason is Unicode code-point bounded, evidence is nonempty and case-insensitive unique, and expected+1 is a safe integer. Body, evidence array and intent are frozen; one random key and exact context If-Match are retained.

root_rulings.subject: Exact success receipt
root_rulings.decision: Returned Review has exact keys and structural validation, current reviewer UUID, task/run/result/policy/expected review/next review version, exact decision/reason and set-equal evidence UUIDs. A malformed or mismatched successful response is uncertain and cannot become an accepted receipt.

root_rulings.subject: First refusal versus unresolved replay
root_rulings.decision: An initial definitive4xx except408/429 marks stale and requires fresh context. Network, malformed success,408/429/5xx keep the immutable intent and explicit retry only. If an already uncertain request later gets4xx, it remains unresolved; that refusal cannot establish whether the first request committed. Duplicate calls while busy/pending do not create a new request.

root_rulings.subject: Draft and response lifecycle
root_rulings.decision: Identity generation/user/org/roles/permissions/case_ids and review.read/review.perform participate in synchronous invalidation. Source case/task/full current context/ETag changes clear drafts, receipts and pending intent and ignore late replies. Current-context reread clears data and ETag before replacement. Parent case/task selection changes, queue paging and route/component unmount dispose the controller; no persistent browser draft storage or restored old intent is introduced.

root_rulings.subject: Current result versus evidence/history paging
root_rulings.decision: Review submission is bound to the current context only. Reading historical records or paging independent evidence does not replace its context. It does not accept selected history as current mutation conditions; selected history remains read-only.

root_rulings.subject: Formal provider boundaries
root_rulings.decision: UI text correctly says missing formal rules/independent-duty providers continues refusal, confirmation is not independent approval, and success only acknowledges appended review records. Four decision labels do not execute task return/rerun, export or approval. Browser/unit fixtures are explicitly self-owned transport samples and cannot prove real identity/rules/backend end-to-end readiness.

root_rulings.subject: Scope and existing tests
root_rulings.decision: Existing review-read and browser source tests show additions only, with no removed old assertions, skip, relaxed CI or dependency changes in the cohort. No backend/SQL/public-contract/model code is modified. Static test inspection does not certify tests ran or CI passed.

root_rulings.subject: Remaining task scope
root_rulings.decision: Page-memory draft and controlled POST are a T103 substep only. Server draft persistence, annotation API, media playback, formal RETURNED successors, real model combinations and full workflow/human review remain outstanding. T102 dependencies and original170source tasks must remain.

dependency_review.audit: T103-C05 controlled review POST and memory-only draft dependency audit
dependency_review.read_scope: Base Git blob bytes are authoritative; current uncommitted frontend implementation was observed but is not reviewed or approved in this dependency audit.

basis: Current hourly nonalgorithm P1 engineering authorization includes human review and evidence binding.
AGENTS permits scoped implementation against the existing authoritative OpenAPI, while missing formal policy must refuse.
The new frontend form does not require changing public endpoint, schema, SQL, enum, lock, CI or formal policy.

dependencies_available.scope: Current review context and strong condition
dependencies_available.evidence: Reviews.context loads the latest actual task_result, task row_version, policy_version, snapshot SHA and MAX(review_version) for the whole task; reply generates a strong SHA-256 ETag over the exact context.
POST /reviews is already mounted, validates ReviewCreate, derives authenticated resource scope using review.perform, and replies 201 Review.

ReviewCreate requires task_id, run_version>=1, result_version>=1, expected_review_version>=0, one of four decisions, reason 1..4096, nonempty unique evidence UUIDs and policy_version 1..128. No client reviewer_id/case_id/approved field is allowed.

Existing If-Match is mandatory: missing428/stale412. ControlReceipts uses real transaction receipts; replay requires the same key and canonical body digest under the same authenticated scope. CONTROL_RECEIPT_TTL_UNCONFIRMED503 remains possible. Preserve immutable pending body/key/ETag across uncertain responses; never silently issue a new key.

Reviews.create rechecks exact task/run/result, current source authority and immutable inputs, same-case/task/run/result evidence, source authorization_version and fixed object integrity before append.

IndependentDuties.review binds task, creator, policy and result versions and rejects person conflicts. Reviews.create checks before replay and again before write. Append of record/evidence links, idempotency and audit occurs in the same DB transaction.

BusinessSession and BusinessClient already own bearer memory, JSON POST with key/ETag, no-store/redirect-error transport, token replacement abort and generation checks. review-read validates exact context/Review structures and current case/read scope; task-cancel supplies an existing pattern for frozen pending requests and uncertain retry.

critical_boundaries.boundary: Existing runtime defaults are not real review readiness
critical_boundaries.evidence: create_app defaults rules=None, independent_duties=None and other authority ports None. development.create_development_app calls create_app(settings); identity.create_identity_app only injects authority=resources.authority. No rule/duty provider is installed by these standard factories.

Absent rules yields REVIEW_RULE_UNAVAILABLE503 if execution reaches Reviews.create. Absent duties yields CONDITIONAL_FACTS_UNAVAILABLE503 after exact result/context checking. Authentication, permission and data-scope failure may be returned earlier; this audit does not promise a particular503 for every default request.

confirm_candidate/reject_candidate/return_for_evidence/request_rerun only select review_record.decision in current code. There is no task state transition, actual rerun scheduling, independent approval, report export or training feedback action. UI success text must describe a recorded review, never completed return/rerun/approval.

Current public OpenAPI has no review draft persistence endpoint or evidence annotation endpoint. In-memory edit retention may be delivered as a sub-scope only; T103 draft saving/full annotation acceptance remains unfinished. Do not use localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB/download as an unreviewed persistent draft substitute.

critical_boundaries.boundary: Do not pretend missing evidence exists
critical_boundaries.evidence: ReviewCreate requires minItems1 for every decision, including return_for_evidence/request_rerun. An empty or fabricated UUID must not bypass this. A page-local evidence miss is not a global absence finding.

critical_boundaries.boundary: Current context only for new submission
critical_boundaries.evidence: Reviews.create compares the requested run/result/policy and expected_review_version to the current latest context; a historical read alone must never authorize submitting against stale data. Re-read current context and use its ETag; stale412/409 does not silently change target or retry a new mutation.

Identity/generation, org, roles, permissions, visible case membership, selected case/task, current result/policy and page teardown must invalidate old editable/submit state and ignore late replies. UI gating is not server authorization.

critical_boundaries.boundary: Source dependencies are not wholesale complete
critical_boundaries.evidence: T070/T078/T097 algorithm combinations and T102 full return/approval workflows are not accepted. This sub-scope reuses real existing endpoints/data structures; it must not close those cards or certify formal multi-person review.

necessary_verification_for_root: Exact context + ETag and one permitted POST request/body/key; all four existing decisions; correct record-only UI labels.
Unauthenticated, missing read/perform permission, hidden/changed case and identity replacement must send no mutation or clear state.
Empty/duplicate/malformed evidence IDs, invalid reason/decision, invalid version/ETag/context and missing user confirmation must send no mutation.
409/412/428 and policy503 keep server refusal; uncertain network/408/429/5xx uses exact pending request on explicit retry, without new key/body/ETag.
Receipt exact task/run/result/policy/review version, reviewer and evidence binding; malformed success is uncertain rather than falsely accepted.
No persistent storage, draft restore across identity, auto rerun/export/approval or real backend success inference from mocked browser transport.
